season.evidence: Searched: trails usually snow-free in early July, snow lingers at the pass and shaded lake edges into July; larch color late Sep-Oct with possible ice on the back side by mid-October. Peakbagger ascents Jun-Oct, October the heaviest. Matches stored Jul-Oct.

track.why: July 18, summited: round trip from our Foggy Dew trailhead (20 m), up the Foggy Dew and Martin Creek trails to Cooney Lake, onto the southeast ridge, summit within 4 m. Report: camped at the lake, scrambled Switchback then Martin. Caveat: the loop also tags Martin Peak and returns over the ridge into Merchants Basin; no route name logged. Switchback has only this southeast-ridge line from Cooney Lake plus the west-ridge variant from Boiling Lake, which this track does not use.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jul 4, from Crater Creek side, Switchback plus Martin, descended Martin NE side; start is the other trailhead (4.7 km from our pin).
Aug 13, Cooney Lake/SE Ridge, Crater Creek start, part of a Switchback-Martin-Bigelow loop; not from our pinned trailhead.
Aug 30 SE Ridge, Crater Creek start, three-peak loop.
Long ridge traverse from Raven Ridge, June 14.
Summer Blossom trail start, June 13, different line.
Logged North Ridge, highest point on another peak.

facts.text: Mosquitoes were heavy at Cooney Lake in early July.
If you continue to Martin Peak in early July, expect snowfields on its northeast side that call for an ice axe and crampons.
Black bears were seen on the Crater Creek side approach in late August.
The last stretch from the pass to the summit is short but leaves the path for loose rock; the Crater Creek trailhead lot can be full on summer weekend nights (August).

season.evidence: Searched: a Mountaineers page describes the west face trail or class 2-3 west ridge but gives no season; surrounding accounts match the standard route (snow-free from July, ice by mid-October). Kept stored Jul-Sep.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jun 13 from Summer Blossom trailhead; direction and month do not establish a Boiling Lake west-ridge line.

notes: Our standard route names only the Foggy Dew trailhead, but most recordings start at the Crater Creek/Eagle Lakes trailhead (4.7 km away, 6 starts); a second trailhead pin could be considered after confirming that coordinate. Assigned track 3283373 also tags Martin Peak.
